_comment: Go again is a printed keyword (printed_keywords) and fires from the card DB keywords field - NOT authored here. ON_ENTER_PLAY puts 2 verse counters on entry (not a continuous STATIC, which would re-add them). WHILE_STATIC with NOT COUNTER_GTE verse 1 implements 'when it has none, destroy it' as a continuous check - re-evaluated whenever counters change. ON_PLAY_ACTIVATE_ATTACK triggers when the controller plays an attack action card (the release note clarifies that discarding an attack action card as a cost for its own instant ability is NOT playing it, so it won't trigger). The once_per_turn key 'malefic_incantation_verse' enforces 'once per turn'. The COUNTER_GTE condition gates the trigger so it only fires while verse counters remain. REMOVE_COUNTERS removes 1 verse counter, then CREATE_TOKEN makes a Runechant token.
